notes: Correction is to the s002 note only; the unit edges, heads and statuses are unchanged. The accepted note described תַּגְדִּילוּ as Hithpael, but MACULA tags it Vhw2mp (Hiphil waw-consecutive). The reflexive *yourselves* still stays with the verb, on the ground that הִגְדִּיל with עַל is elative *magnify oneself* and the English reflexive renders the verb's own sense rather than supplying an object the Hebrew does not write.
Two coordinated verbs share one written English subject *ye*; it stays with the first verb's unit and the second takes only *have multiplied* (rule 22).
Both possessive suffixes precede their host nouns in English, so those units are ordered by source ID rather than target position (rule 25).
